add.heading: Add a feed
add.url: Address of the feed or of its site
admin.auth.anonymous: Visitors who are not signed in may read what %s reads
admin.auth.anonymous-refresh: and may have the feeds refreshed
admin.auth.auto-register: Create a user for a name the reverse proxy or the provider vouches for and nobody has
admin.auth.force-email: A user has to confirm their e-mail address before using the account
admin.auth.form: a login with name and password
admin.auth.hint: Without a login everybody who reaches the server is let in: leave that to a server only you can reach.
admin.auth.http_auth: the reverse proxy in front of the server (Remote-User)
admin.auth.no-mail: The server was started without an SMTP server (-smtp-url): it cannot send the letters that confirm addresses.
admin.auth.none: nothing: everybody is the default user
admin.auth.oidc: Signing in through a provider (OpenID Connect)
admin.auth.oidc.admin-group.hint: Whoever the provider puts in this group, in the claim groups of the ID token, is an administrator here, and whoever it does not is not, from their next sign-in through it. Leave it empty to grant administration here.
admin.auth.oidc.hint: Next to the login by password. Register a client at the provider with the callback address %s. A user is bound to who they are at the provider (the subject) at their first sign-in: to the user named in preferred_username, made if there is none and automatic registration is on. Leave both fields empty for no provider.
admin.auth.oidc.no-secret: The server was started without the secret of the client (-oidc-client-secret): nobody can sign in through a provider until it is.
admin.authentication.heading: Signing in
admin.log.heading: Journal of everybody
admin.problem.lockout: This way of telling users apart would not know you: the reverse proxy has to name you on this very request, and the default user has to exist.
admin.problem.name: This cannot be a user name.
admin.problem.name-taken: A user has this name already.
admin.problem.no-mail: Addresses cannot be confirmed without an SMTP server: start the server with -smtp-url first.
admin.problem.no-password: You have no password for the web interface: with signing in by password you would be locked out. Set one in your profile first.
admin.problem.number: The numbers have to be zero or more.
admin.problem.oidc: The provider takes both an address starting with https:// and a client ID, or neither.
admin.problem.protected: This cannot be done to your own account or to that of the default user.
admin.problem.proxy: The proxy has to be an address such as socks5://127.0.0.1:1080, with the scheme http, https, socks5 or socks5h.
admin.system.allowlist: Internal addresses feeds may be fetched from
admin.system.allowlist.hint: Set with -fetch-allowlist when the server starts; addresses of this machine and of private networks are refused otherwise.
admin.system.closed-message: What visitors read when registration is closed
admin.system.cookie-days: Days a remembered login lasts without being used
admin.system.heading: System
admin.system.language: Language for visitors whose browser asks for none of ours
admin.system.max-registrations: Users from which on nobody can register
admin.system.max-registrations.hint: 1 closes registration, 0 leaves it open for good.
admin.system.media: Images of entries the server hands out from its own address
admin.system.media.hint: The sites then see the server and not the reader. Images served over http are not shown on a page served over https unless the server hands them out.
admin.system.proxy.chosen-only: Only the feeds that choose this proxy go through it
admin.system.proxy.chosen-only.hint: A feed chooses it in its settings, without typing the address. Everything else is fetched directly.
admin.system.proxy.hint: For example http://proxy.example:3128 or socks5h://user:password@127.0.0.1:1080. A feed with a proxy of its own keeps it. Empty for none.
admin.system.reauth-minutes: Minutes after which administration asks for the password again (0 for never)
admin.system.title: Name of the installation
admin.system.tos.hint: With terms, a visitor has to accept them to register. Empty for none.
admin.user.delete.confirm: The user is deleted with every feed, entry and setting. This cannot be undone.
admin.user.name.hint: Up to 39 Latin letters, digits and _ . @ -, starting with a letter, a digit or _.
admin.user.password.hint: For the web interface and for apps alike. Whoever is signed in with the old one is signed out.
admin.user.protected: Your own account and that of the default user cannot be kept out, demoted or deleted here.
admin.user.totp: Signing in by password asks this user for the code of an app. Turn it off for a user who lost the app.
admin.users.heading: Users
bar.label: Actions on entries
category.among: Among how many of the newest entries
category.among.hint: 0 stands for every entry of the category.
category.default: The category of feeds without one cannot be renamed.
category.delete.confirm: The category is deleted; its feeds move to the category of feeds without one.

category.empty.confirm.one: %d feed of the category is deleted with its entries.
category.empty.confirm.other: %d feeds of the category are deleted with their entries.

category.heading: Settings of a category
category.opml.failed: The last attempt to read the document failed.
category.opml.hint: With an address, the feeds of the category are those the document lists: feeds are added and muted as the document changes.
category.position.hint: Categories with a place come first, lowest number first. Leave it empty for no place.
category.same-guid: Mark an entry as read when another one of the category has its identifier
category.same-title: Mark an entry as read when another one of the category has its title
error.400.heading: Request not understood
error.400.text: The server could not read this request.
error.403.heading: Not allowed
error.403.text: You do not have access to this page.
error.404.heading: Page not found
error.404.text: There is nothing at this address.
error.405.heading: Not possible here
error.405.text: This address does not take this kind of request.
error.500.heading: Something went wrong
error.500.text: The server could not finish the request. The details are in its log.
feed.check.heading: How the feed answers
feed.check.hint: Requests the feed as this form has it, without a proxy and through every proxy there is. Nothing is stored.
feed.check.hint.admin: The feed does not answer the server directly, and the installation has no proxy to try. One is set on the page "System"; the check can then be repeated.
feed.check.hint.installation: The feed answers through the proxy of the installation and not directly: choose "That of the installation" under "Proxy" and save.
feed.check.hint.user: The feed does not answer the server directly, and the installation has no proxy to try. Give the feed a proxy of its own, or ask the administrator for one.
feed.check.settings: The feed cannot be requested with these settings: the kind of proxy is not one the server goes through, or its address is not one.
feed.check.way.installation: Through the proxy of the installation
feed.check.way.own: Through the proxy of the feed
feed.content-action: What the text of the page does to the text of the feed
feed.cookie-file: Keep the cookies a redirect sets
feed.delete.confirm: The feed and every entry of it are deleted.
feed.failing: The last refresh failed, at %s. The log of the server says why.
feed.fulltext.auto: Find the article on its page without a selector
feed.fulltext.auto.hint: The text of every new entry is taken from the page it links to, the way the reader view of a browser finds it. The selector of the article is then not used.
feed.fulltext.browser: Read the pages with a browser
feed.fulltext.browser.hint: For a site that lets only a browser through to its pages, as behind a check of Cloudflare. It does nothing by itself: pages are read when the article is looked for without a selector, or a selector is given. The browser of the server opens every page, which takes seconds; the proxy, the cookies and the user agent set for the feed do not apply to it.
feed.heading: Settings of a feed
feed.http-password.hint: Leave it empty to keep the password there is.
feed.icon.file: A picture of your own, up to 1 MB
feed.icon.reset: Go back to the icon of the site
feed.kind.rss-forced: RSS or Atom, whatever the document looks like
feed.max-unread: Unread entries the feed may hold; older ones become read
feed.mute: Muted: the feed is not refreshed
feed.preview: Try it on the newest entry
feed.preview.browser-alone: The pages are to be read by a browser, but nothing says how the article is found on them: check "Find the article on its page without a selector" or give a selector.
feed.preview.empty: Nothing is taken from the page.
feed.preview.failed: The page could not be read, no article was found on it, or the selector is not valid CSS.
feed.preview.heading: What is taken from the newest entry
feed.preview.no-entries: The feed has no entry with a link to try it on.
feed.preview.no-selector: There is no selector to try, and the article is not looked for without one.
feed.priority.feed: On the page of the feed only
feed.priority.hidden: Hidden: on the page of the feed only
feed.priority.important: In the main stream, as important
feed.problem.proxy: The server does not go through SOCKS4 and SOCKS4A proxies: the feed fails at every refresh until another kind of proxy is chosen, SOCKS5 for instance.
feed.proxy.none: As the installation has it for every feed
feed.read-upon-gone: Mark entries as read when the feed no longer lists them
feed.read-upon-reception: Mark entries as read when they arrive
feed.redirects: Redirects to follow at most (empty for the usual number, 0 for none, -1 for any)
feed.same-title: Mark an entry as read when one of the newest entries has its title: among how many (0 turns it off)
feed.selector: CSS selector of the article on its page
feed.selector-conditions: Take the page only for entries that match
feed.selector-filter: CSS selector of what to leave out
feed.selector.hint: With a selector, the text of every new entry is taken from the page it links to.
feed.truncate.confirm: Every entry of the feed is deleted, starred ones too. The feed stays.
feed.ttl: Do not refresh more often than every
feed.ttl.automatic: Automatic, by how often the feed publishes
feed.unicity.forced: Keep to this even when it does not tell the entries apart
feed.unicity.id: the identifier the feed gives them
feed.unicity.sha1:title: title
feed.updated-unread: Mark an entry as unread when the feed changes it
feed.xpath: XPath expressions, for a web page or an XML document
feed.xpath-to-json: XPath of the JSON inside the page
form.empty-inherits: Leave a field empty to go by the settings of the user.
form.filters-hint: One search a line, in the search language of the reading screen.
form.filters-read: Mark as read the entries that match
form.name: Name
integrations.address.hint: For services you run yourself or have an account at: Mastodon, wallabag, Shaarli and the like.
integrations.intro: The services listed here are offered in the menu “Share” of every entry.
integrations.name: Name in the menu
integrations.name.hint: Empty for the name of the service.
integrations.problem.address: The address of a service has to start with http:// or https://.
integrations.token.hint: For Linkding. With the token from its settings an entry is saved there at once, without the form of Linkding.
integrations.token.stored: A token is stored and is not shown. Leave the field empty to keep it.
js.failed: The action failed. Reload the page and try again.
js.help.fixed-enter: Open or close the entry in focus
js.help.fixed-escape: Close a dialog, leave a field
js.mark-all: Mark every unread entry listed here as read?
js.no-linkding: No Linkding with an API token is set up: see Settings, Integrations.
js.no-share: No way to share is set up: see Settings, Integrations.
js.palette.hint: Type to find a feed, a category, a label, a page or an action
key.fulltext: Take the text from the page of the entry, or put the text of the feed back
key.go-keys: Go to the settings of keys
key.next-node: Next feed or stream in the tree
key.original: Open the original in a new tab
key.page: Scroll the entry, then open the next one
key.prev-node: Previous feed or stream in the tree
key.skip-next: Go to the next entry without opening it
key.skip-prev: Go to the previous entry without opening it
key.translate: Translate the entry, or show its original
key.unread-node: Next feed or stream with unread entries
keys.failed: The keys were not saved: some of them cannot be used as they are.
keys.heading: Keys
keys.intro: Every action of the reading screen has a key. Leave a field empty to take the key away; the action stays in the command palette.
keys.notation: A key is a character (j, J, ?), a named key (Space, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Backspace, Delete, Insert, F1 to F12), either one with Ctrl+, Alt+ or Meta+ before it, or two keys pressed one after the other, written with a space between them (g u). Enter, Escape and Ctrl+K always do the same.
keys.single: Keys pressed alone, without Ctrl, Alt or Meta, are on
label.delete.confirm: The label is taken off every entry and deleted. The entries stay.
label.filters: Give the label to new entries that match
label.heading: Settings of a label
log.clear.confirm: Every record about you is deleted.
log.clear.confirm.all: Every record about every user is deleted.
log.intro: Warnings and errors of the server about your feeds, kept for 30 days.
log.intro.all: Warnings and errors of the server about the feeds of every user, kept for 30 days.
login.code.expired: The sign-in took too long or had too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
login.code.heading: Code from the app
login.code.hint: The six digits your authenticator app shows for this account now.
login.code.wrong: This code is not the one. Try the code the app shows now.
login.heading: Sign in

login.locked.one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in %d minute.
login.locked.other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in %d minutes.

login.oidc.failed: Signing in through the provider did not work. Try again, or ask the administrator.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
mark-all.label: Mark as read…
notice.category-default: The category of feeds without one cannot be deleted.
notice.category-limit: You have as many categories as this installation allows.
notice.email-wait: A letter went out a moment ago. Look for it, or ask again later.
notice.feed-browser-alone: Saved, but no page is read yet: the pages are to be read by a browser, and nothing says how the article is found on them. Check "Find the article on its page without a selector" or give a selector.
notice.feed-failed: The feed could not be refreshed. The log of the server says why.

notice.feed-texts.one: Saved. %d unread entry got another text.
notice.feed-texts.other: Saved. %d unread entries got another text.

notice.fulltext-check: The page stays behind a check of its site, which did not let the browser of the server through.
notice.fulltext-failed: The text could not be taken from the page of the entry. The log of the server says why.

notice.imported.one: Imported: %d feed or entry added or updated.
notice.imported.other: Imported: %d feeds and entries added or updated.

notice.imported-partly.one: Imported in part: %d feed or entry added or updated; something was left out, see the limits of the installation and the file.
notice.imported-partly.other: Imported in part: %d feeds and entries added or updated; something was left out, see the limits of the installation and the file.

notice.label-long: The name of the label is too long; the label was not created.
notice.label-taken: A category has this name already; the label was not created.
notice.linkding-failed: The entry could not be saved to Linkding. The log of the server says why.
notice.linkding-refused: Linkding refused the token: see Settings, Integrations.
notice.opml-failed: The OPML document could not be read. The log of the server says why.
notice.opml-none: The category has no OPML document.
notice.password-reset: The password is changed. Sign in with it.
notice.query-token: The public addresses of the query have changed; the old ones no longer work.
notice.refresh-busy: The feeds are being refreshed already.
notice.token-regenerated: The token has changed; the old addresses of your feeds no longer work.
notice.undo-conflict: This cannot be undone: something of the same name or number has been made meanwhile.
notice.undo-gone: There is nothing to undo: an action can be undone for 10 minutes, until the next one, and not after a restart of the server.
notice.totp-off: Signing in takes the password alone again.
notice.totp-on: Signing in now asks for the code of your app.
notice.translate-failed: The entry could not be translated. The log of the server says why.
notice.translate-partly: Translated, but some paragraphs could not be and stand as they were.
notice.translate-same: The entry is in that language already.
order.label: Order

problems.failed.one: Failed at %[2]s, %[1]d time in a row: %[3]s
problems.failed.other: Failed at %[2]s, %[1]d times in a row: %[3]s

problems.heading: Feeds that need a look
problems.hold.backoff: it waits longer after each failure in a row
problems.hold.fresh: its server called the last answer fresh until then (Cache-Control or Expires)
problems.hold.retry-after: its server asked not to be requested before then (Retry-After)
problems.hold.websub: its WebSub hub delivers the new entries, so it is polled once a day
problems.next.run: Next refresh at the next run.
problems.no-message: the cause is in the log of the server
query.broken: its feed, category or label is gone
query.delete.confirm: The query is deleted, and its public addresses with it. Entries stay.
query.exclude-tags: Leave the tags of entries out of the feed
query.image: Address of a picture for the feed
query.include-labels: Name my labels in the feed
query.intro: A saved query is a stream with its state, order and search under a name. It stands in the tree and in the command palette, searches can refer to it (search:name), and it can be handed out as a feed.
query.links.hint: Whoever has one of these addresses gets the query without signing in.
query.none: No saved queries. The reading screen saves the view it shows.
query.share-opml: Anybody with the address may get the feeds as OPML and the entries as JSON
query.share-rss: Anybody with the address may read the entries, as a feed and as a page
query.stream.A: Every feed but the hidden ones
query.token.confirm: The query gets new addresses; the ones handed out so far stop working.
reauth.heading: Confirm it is you
reauth.intro: Administration asks for your password again after a while.
register.busy: Too many accounts were made here in the last hour. Try again later.
register.closed: Nobody can register here at the moment. Ask the administrator for an account.
register.email.hint: A letter with a link goes to this address; the account works once the link is followed.
register.heading: Create an account

register.locked.one: Too many accounts from your address. Try again in %d minute.
register.locked.other: Too many accounts from your address. Try again in %d minutes.

register.no-mail: Nobody can register here: the server cannot send the letter that confirms an address.
register.problem.terms: The terms have to be accepted.
reset.heading: Reset the password
reset.intro: Enter your user name. If the account has a confirmed e-mail address, a letter with a link to choose a new password goes there.
reset.mail.body:
Hello %s,

somebody, probably you, asked for a new password of your account at %s.
To choose one, open this link within an hour:

%s

If it was not you, do nothing: the password stays as it is.
reset.mail.subject: A new password — %s
reset.sent: If the account has a confirmed e-mail address, a letter with a link is on its way. The link works once, for an hour.
retention.own: This one has rules of its own
retention.period-on: Delete entries the feed has not listed for a time
search.label: Search
search.regexp: The search has a regular expression that is not supported: backreferences and lookarounds cannot be used.
search.too-deep: The search has too many nested parentheses.
settings.api-password.has: Apps can connect with the password you have set.
settings.api-password.hint: An empty password takes the access of apps away.
settings.api-password.none: Apps cannot connect: there is no password for them.
settings.archiving.heading: Archiving
settings.auto-load-more: Load the next page when the end of the list comes near
settings.delete.confirm: Your account is deleted with every feed, entry and setting of it. This cannot be undone.
settings.display.heading: Display
settings.hide-read-feeds: Leave feeds without unread entries out of the tree while unread entries are listed
settings.integrations.heading: Integrations
settings.keys.heading: Keys
settings.log.heading: Journal
settings.mark.article: Mark an entry as read when it is opened
settings.mark.max-unread: Unread entries a feed may hold
settings.mark.max-unread-on: Bound the unread entries a feed may hold
settings.mark.same-title-on: Mark an entry as read when one of the newest entries of its feed has its title
settings.privacy.heading: Privacy
settings.problem.default-user: The default user of the installation cannot be deleted.
settings.problem.email: This is not an e-mail address.
settings.problem.host: A host is a name such as www.example.org, without a scheme and a path.
settings.problem.password-long: A password has at most 72 bytes.
settings.problem.password-short: A password has at least 7 characters.
settings.problem.password-wait: Too many wrong passwords. Try again later.
settings.problem.posts-per-page: A page lists from 1 to 500 entries.
settings.problem.timezone: There is no such time zone.
settings.problem.token: A token is up to 191 characters without spaces.
settings.problem.totp-code: This code is not the one the app shows for this secret.
settings.problem.totp-password: A code from an app goes with a password: set a password first.
settings.problem.translate-to: There is no such language tag.
settings.profile.heading: Profile
settings.purge.hint: Applies the rules above, and those of feeds and categories, without waiting for the feeds to be refreshed.
settings.queries.heading: Saved queries
settings.reading.heading: Reading
settings.referrer: Hosts whose embedded frames learn where you come from
settings.referrer.hint: One host a line. Some video players do not play without it. Everything else an entry embeds learns nothing about this installation.
settings.row: The row of an entry in a list names
settings.show-fav-unread: List all entries in the starred ones and in labels
settings.timezone.hint: A name such as Europe/Berlin. Empty for the time zone of the server.
settings.token.hint: Whoever has the token can read your entries as a feed without signing in. Empty for nobody.
settings.token.links: With the token your entries and subscriptions are at these addresses:
settings.token.regenerate.hint: Makes a new random token. The addresses with the old one stop working, so feed readers that use them need the new ones.

settings.totp.on: Signing in by password asks for the code of your app. To turn this off, enter your password and a code of the app.
settings.totp.qr: QR code of the secret for an authenticator app
settings.ttl-default: Refresh a feed without a period of its own at least every
settings.ttl-default.hint: A feed that publishes more often than that is refreshed more often.
settings.view.adaptive: Unread entries while there are any, else all
